title: RecSys Two-Tower — Retrieval + LightGBM Ranking with Recall@K / NDCG@K

modules.dataset: Synthetic recommendation ETL with latent-factor user/item embeddings. Implicit (clicked) + explicit (rating 1-5) feedback. Temporal + leave-one-out splits. User/item metadata features.
modules.model: Two-Tower PyTorch retrieval (UserTower + ItemTower DNNs → 64-D L2-normalized embeddings). InfoNCE loss (in-batch softmax). FAISS IndexFlatIP for cosine search. LightGBM LambdaMART ranker on candidate-pair features (element-wise product + cosine sim + metadata).
modules.train: argparse CLI: --num-users, --num-items, --n-interactions, --embedding-dim, --epochs, --batch-size, --lr, --temperature, --k-candidates, --lgbm-n-estimators, --metrics-json, --metrics-plot. Trains two-tower → indexes items → evaluates retrieval → trains ranking → evaluates ranking.
modules.tests: 15 tests: embedding L2 norm = 1.0 (both towers), InfoNCE perfect-match/orthogonal/non-negative, Recall@K non-decreasing monotonicity + perfect, NDCG@K bounded [0,1] + perfect, MRR bounded [0,1] + perfect, FAISS add+search correctness, LightGBM fit+predict sanity, temporal split integrity, CLI smoke.

entry_point: python train.py [--num-users N] [--num-items N] [--n-interactions N] --metrics-json metrics.json
